verdict.rationale: Mollie, a payments SaaS rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server. It is hosted at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp, covers 13 APIs (Payments, Payment Links, Subscriptions, Webhooks, etc.), uses scoped Advanced access tokens with per-API scopes enabling each tool, and ships client configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code. The probe confirms the docs page exists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the server works as documented, plus coverage of remaining APIs such as refunds, chargebacks and Connect.
